title: EU nationals will pay higher tuition fees than UK students, Burnham indicates
summary_full: Asked by Kemi Badenoch to rule out equal rate for UK and EU students, PM says proposal ‘will not be put on the table’European students will have to pay higher fees than their domestic equivalents at UK universities under a still-to-be-finalised part of the new deal with the EU, Andy Burnham has indicated.The issue of fees paid by EU nationals studying at British universities is the main element of the arrangement hailed by Burnham in Brussels on Friday that has not been agreed, with both sides giving an extra six months to reach a solution.
